title: Rare-Tail Statistics For Learning Biased Gaussian Halfspaces with Label Noise
abstract: arXiv:2611.24181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We revisit the classical problem of learning general Gaussian halfspaces in the presence of label noise, with particular focus on the large-bias regime, where information-computation gaps are conjectured in several standard label-noise models. Concretely, we present and analyze the rare-tail mean estimator, an extremely simple one-shot statistic that averages only the observed minority class. In the large-bias regime, classical Averaging (Servedio, 1999) and related global first-moment statistics are provably suboptimal, while the rare-tail mean estimator recovers the target halfspace direction at the information-theoretic sample rate (modulo log factors) under a broad class of label noise models, including probit noise and margin-dependent noise with very slow decay away from the boundary. Notably, our guarantees allow labels arbitrarily close to the decision boundary to be nearly random, while still giving strong directional recovery

translated_title: 面向带标签噪声的偏置高斯半空间学习的稀有尾部统计方法
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了在标签噪声存在下学习一般高斯半空间的经典问题，并特别关注大偏置区间——在该区间中，若干标准标签噪声模型被猜想存在信息与计算之间的差距。具体而言，我们提出并分析了稀有尾部均值估计量，这是一种极其简单的一次性统计量，仅对观测到的少数类进行平均。在大偏置区间中，经典的平均法（Servedio, 1999）及相关的全局一阶矩统计量被证明是次优的，而稀有尾部均值估计量则在广泛的标签噪声模型类下，以信息论最优的样本率（除去对数因子）恢复目标半空间方向，这些模型包括概率单位噪声以及远离决策边界时衰减极慢的间隔相关噪声。值得注意的是，我们的理论保证允许任意接近决策边界的标签近乎完全随机，同时仍能实现强大的方向恢复能力。
tldr: 本文提出“稀有尾部均值估计量”这一极简统计方法，在大偏置高斯半空间带标签噪声的学习问题中，以信息论最优样本率恢复目标半空间方向，超越了经典平均法等全局一阶矩统计量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the rare-tail mean estimator, an extremely simple one-shot statistic that recovers the target halfspace direction at the information-theoretic sample rate in the large-bias regime under broad label noise models, where classical averaging and global first-moment statistics are provably suboptimal.
